title: Decorative Stairs and Slabs
text: Light, spiritual and dream crystals, their bricks, shadow rock variants, mirror stone and its void-touched variants, and shadow planks have stair and slab forms.
Craft six blocks into four stairs, or three blocks in a row into six slabs. Stone and crystal can also be stonecut into one stair or two slabs per block.

Different materials connect under vanilla stair rules, including upside-down corners. Light is retained. Mirror stone and its variants are weightless. Single luminous crystal slabs retain half buoyancy; double slabs restore full buoyancy.
